frames.u: A number keeps the customer talking

reel2.caption:
A customer asks how much it is. Do not say it depends and leave it there.

Give a price or a range, say what it includes, ask one or two questions to make the quote accurate, then offer a day and time. Customers move on when they cannot get a number.

slides.sub: Six things to decide on purpose. Swipe.

slides.title: The offer
slides.head: I help ___ with ___ in ___.
slides.body: Be specific. Everyone is not a customer. Picture one real person who pays you.

slides.title: Why me
slides.head: Pick one or two reasons.
slides.body: Speed, price upfront, a specialty. Make sure it is true and customers can see it.

slides.title: Prices
slides.head: Write your main prices down.
slides.body: Add your deposit and payment terms so you never have to guess.

slides.title: Customers
slides.head: Choose three ways, not twelve.
slides.body: Referrals, WhatsApp and local groups work well. Write what you will do each week.

slides.title: The numbers
slides.head: Fixed costs plus the pay you want.
slides.body: Divide by profit per sale to see how many sales you need each month.

slides.title: Next 90 days
slides.head: Three goals you can measure.
slides.body: Get 8 paying customers beats be successful. Add one first action for each.
